steps.content: Your body isn't used to such strenuous exercise yet, and the murky air in the sewers makes you exhausted.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I remember them. They're <color=#fb9259>the Legion</color>! The most impressive gang in Syndicate these recent years. All the gangs are scared of them!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Was it their boss who made the Public Security Bureau with one blow? Wow! Don't tell me even she is targeting you?! I remember she's called, hmm... Zo—

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: She's the most terrifying monster in Syndicate. If she hadn't destroyed our order, Syndicate wouldn't be in such a state...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You can't fall into her hands, nor can any of us.
You think of the figure on the high-rise, which sends chills down your spine. Ted is analyzing something to himself as he mutters quickly and his face turns pale.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>Why is she here? Have we lost our cover? When? Damn it, only they...</size></color>

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>No, they didn't go to the hospital, which means they don't know yet... the decoy has worked... That's right, that's why they had to come to the Public Security Bureau to find intel, which had already been disposed of...</size></color>

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>That's right. There's still a way. We've still got time...</size></color>

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Come back to the stronghold with me. My men are there watching SALVA. They can fight too. And plus your Sinners, we can win.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content:
It'll do if we attack SALVA before the Legion does and get the target out.
Go, now. Hurry up!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hold on.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's too risky. We must abort the operation if the Chief's safety is at risk.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Shut up. You just need to follow orders as a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I only follow the Chief's orders.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, should we proceed with the operation?
This is the worst opening possible. There is a leak of your intelligence, your support has been destroyed, and you don't know who betrayed you and who is on to you.
But...
Go witness the end of this revelry. Whatever happens, don't look away. If you can do it...
I'll be waiting for you at the end with all the answers you've been looking for.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Please tell me your decision.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The department only "discovered" the whereabouts of the fugitives and suspected her of being a suspect R. This intel can be wrong.
That's okay. You want to see her again and have many questions to ask her. Just allow yourself to take every small chance to catch her.
Besides, the target will shift soon. This may be the last chance.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Got it, I'll protect you.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Wise decision. Let's go. There may be riots on the road to the stronghold at any time. I'll find you some camouflage, but prepare yourself to fight at any time.
You nod then look at Hella. She has been very quiet.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you looking at me for? Go on. You have decided now. I'm not gonna go against you, am I?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But I'm just putting it out there—I hate gangsters. This jerk is definitely just using us. Don't trust him too much, dumbass.
You know it. You don't trust him completely. In fact, you have nothing to fully trust, including your memory.
